newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Tennis-Spaniard Moya brushes past McEnroe.
newsitem.headline: Tennis-Spaniard Moya brushes past McEnroe.

text.p: Spanish giant-killer Carlos Moya, who dumped champion Boris Becker out of the Australian Open in the first round, enjoyed a solid second round win on Wednesday over American Patrick McEnroe.
McEnroe, a semifinalist in Melbourne in 1991 and younger brother to tennis great John, took the first set 6-3.

But unseeded Moya, a clay court specialist ranked 25th in the world, powered back into the game to win 3-6 6-0 6-3 6-1. He will meet either Thomas Johansson of Sweden or Germany's Bernd Karbacher in the third round.
